items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Something like Bechet, something, you know, you can tell, but still it's different.

ctx.x: Well, Miley worked with me on my first getting together with the band. At that time I could play the songs, but I couldn't make those endings, those jazz endings. And the first job he worked with me, he was working with Chris, but something happened, he went to Beerus, Chris gave me the job, went to Beerus with me, and he made all the endings for me. When he comes to stop this band, when he had to do that I couldn't stop, I couldn't play, but I couldn't stop.

He's one of my favorite clarinet players. Really? I don't know anybody that plays exactly like him, you know, that I can think of. No, he was tops. Did anybody else play on his order, his style? Not that I know of. Something like Bechet, something, you know, you can tell, but still it's different. He's got some of his own licks and things that nobody else does.
And he played a while after Paul went into the service. And then I take him at the Palace. Pretty good while. He stayed there with me.
